name: Phoenix
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Phoenix for 2026, and here is what he found: 29 family events, 13 of them free. The magic runs from November 12 (World of Illumination: Candy Rush) through January 15, with ZooLights (from November 25), Winter Wonderland at Ahwatukee First Fridays (December 4), the APS Electric Light Parade (December 5), Santa Visits and Snow Flurries at Children's Museum of Phoenix (December 5 and 6) and Christmas Party with Santa at Great Arizona Puppet Theater (December 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Phoenix

  • 29 Christmas events for kids in Phoenix
  • 13 free events, including Preschool Polar Palooza, Ugly Sweater Party at Sunnyslope Youth Center and Holidays at the Heard Museum
  • Meet Santa: Santa Visits and Snow Flurries at Children's Museum of Phoenix (December 5 and 6), Christmas Party with Santa (December 20) and Cookies and Cocoa with Santa on Peoria Avenue (December 6)
  • Parades and lights: APS Electric Light Parade (December 5), ZooLights and Las Noches de las Luminarias
  • Also new: The Night Before Christmas puppet show and The Arizona Nutcracker at Madison Center for the Arts
  • Season: November 12 to January 15

Planning a bigger day out? Phoenix families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Scottsdale, which covers Holiday Lights at McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park, Christmas at the Princess and Photos with Santa at Scottsdale Fashion Square.
